articles.summary: Sallie Explains What Students and Families Need to Know About This Year’s FAFSA® and How to Get Started The 2027-28 Free Application for Federal Student Aid (FAFSA®) is now open, giving incoming and current college students extra time to apply for financial aid for the 2027-28 school year. Completing the FAFSA® is the first step to accessing federal, state, and school-based financial aid for college, including grants , scholarships , work-study , and other aid. Some aid is limited or awarded on a first-come, first-served basis, so filing early can make a real difference for students and families and ultimately, could mean paying less out of pocket for college. That said, only 25% of families know the form opens in the fall. Why Should More Families Complete the FAFSA®? Just about every family who completes the FAFSA ® qualifies for some form of financial aid, yet many never file.
